ambiguities.description: The multiplicity of Student enrolls in CourseOffering is not explicitly stated as many-to-many. It is implied that a student can enroll in multiple offerings and an offering can have multiple students, but no explicit uniqueness/mandatory constraints were discussed for this fact type itself (only for the grade fact type). Confirm whether enrollment has its own attributes (e.g., enrollment date) or is purely a many-to-many relationship.
